### Free Plan

- **Cost:** $0 per month. Includes unlimited users.

- Integration with external phone numbers.
- Upgrade options for automation, storage, and advanced CRM features.

### Basic Plan
What it is: Bitrix24’s entry-level paid plan designed for small teams looking to streamline collaboration, manage clients, and enable basic calling—all within a unified platform.

Cost: $49 per month per organization (billed annually). Includes up to 5 users.

### Standard Plan
**What it is:** A mid-tier Bitrix24 plan aimed at growing teams that need expanded user capacity, stronger CRM tools, and built-in marketing capabilities—plus enhanced support for collaborative work.

**Cost:** $87 per month per organization (billed annually). Includes up to 50 users.

**Includes:**

- All features from the Basic plan.
- Advanced CRM functionality with sales funnel automation and web forms.
- Online document editing and team knowledge base.
- Marketing tools like email campaigns and audience segmentation.

### Professional Plan

- Bitrix24 combines customer relationship management with project tracking, giving teams one platform to manage sales and internal operations.
- You can assign tasks, monitor progress, and automate client touchpoints—all from a shared dashboard.
- **What Could Be Better?** Automation options and CRM extensions are only fully unlocked in higher-tier plans.

## Bitrix24 Pros & Cons
| PROS | CONS |
|-|-|
| **Flat Pricing Model** – Pay per organization, not per user. | **Strict User Caps** – Exceeding user limits forces a full plan upgrade. |
| **Built-In Telephony** – Make and receive calls directly in-app. | **Paid Calling Credits** – Outbound VoIP requires purchased credits. |
| **Integrated CRM + Task Management** – Combines client and project data. | **Limited Dialer Control** – No advanced call flows in lower-tier plans. |
| **Online Document Editing & E-signatures** – Included in most plans. | **Storage Limits** – Extra charges apply if you exceed plan allowance. |
| **Multi-Tool Platform** – Chat, projects, CRM, telephony, and more. | **Feature Gating** – Sales automation and full telephony gated by tier. |
